name: 1D Slice Reconstruction with Piecewise Constant Model
aliases: 1D slice reconstruction with piecewise constant model
definition: Reconstruction of a 2D slice from parallel projections by modeling the slice as a 1D piecewise constant function with n parameters, solving for these parameters by comparing projected data with model projections.
summary: This method reconstructs a 2D slice from parallel projections by modeling it as a 1D piecewise constant function and solving for parameters via constrained minimization of a regularized quadratic criterion.
